description: The trip a FareDice trip link names, as find_trips returns one: its flights with fares, their ages, times where known and cabin-bag notes, nights in each place and the total, with its home hops when it starts from a home airport. A trip whose fares have gone says so and gives the nearest days the same places all have fares again, or none. 20 calls a day per caller (UTC) of find_trips, get_trip, swap_stop and edit_trip are free; after that each costs US$0.01, paid with x402 (USDC on Base). nonstop_fares and nonstop_from are always free.

link.description: A FareDice trip link, as find_trips returns it (https://faredice.com/trip?l=... or /sea/trip?l=...).

name: get_trip
title: Open a FareDice trip from its link
